The program included well-known Ukrainian songs such as “Shchedryk” and “Dobryi vechir tobi, pane hospodariu.” The performance was conducted by Vadym Yatsenko. Social media users praised the choir, saying its performance brought a touch of magic to people during these difficult times. 📹 : veryovka/Instagram
